caption: Illuminated pedestrian bridge lined with railings and palm trees leading toward the Marina Bay Sands complex at night, its three hotel towers and rooftop deck glowing with purple and yellow lights against a dark sky.

Ancient stone amphitheater with multiple arches viewed from below at night, illuminated by blue-tinted lighting. A bright full moon hangs in a starry sky above, while a narrow beam of light from the lower right points upward toward the sky.

Ancient stone amphitheater with multiple rows of illuminated arches at dusk, set against a deep blue sky. Warm yellow lighting glows from within the structure, highlighting its curved facade and weathered details. A tall, narrow tree stands in the foreground near the right side. Small groups of people walk and gather along the perimeter at ground level, separated from the building by low barriers.

Large ancient temple façade at night with a triangular pediment, massive stone columns, and a central wooden door, all illuminated by warm lights. Small figures stand at the base. The inscription on the pediment reads: “M AGRIPPA L F COS TERTIVM FECIT.”

Illuminated cityscape at night featuring The Shard with its upper section glowing bright pink, surrounded by modern office buildings, including a cylindrical tower marked “Hilton.” Below, a brightly lit bridge with pink accents spans a river, whose surface reflects multicolored lights from the bridge and surrounding buildings.
